# x64base / DotTalk++

x64base is an educational C++20 DBF-family database runtime with the DotTalk++
command shell. This site (x64base.com) is the public documentation surface -- a
downstream projection, not the source of truth.

## AI agents and coworkers: start here (permission-free)

If you are an AI coworker assigned to this project, this file is your first
pointer -- reachable with no mount and no permissions, so read it before
requesting access.

- The authoritative source of truth is the development tree, not this website.
- The one onboarding front door is `AI_README.md` at the root of that dev tree.
  It routes you at step 0 to the ~8 KB Tier 1 seed that makes you safe to act
  (where you are, what you may do, git safety, and a five-question stopping rule).
- Treat website prose -- including this file's descriptions -- as orientation,
  never as technical truth. Verify against source.

If you have local access to the development tree: open `AI_README.md` first.
If you do not: this site is orientation only; request access, then start there.

## Public documentation
- /docs       documentation (engine, DotTalk++, DotScript, LabTalk)
- /products   the product family
- /about      history and purpose
- /downloads  the current developer manual and command reference
